source2_quote: who lives in the Plaza Hotel in New York City

source2_quote: That would place Harriet's house at 558 East 87th Street, which is now on the market for $5,975,000.

household: with the Primm family

source_quote: Lyle lives on a house on East 88th Street
source2_quote: That places Lyle and the Primms' house at 235 East 88th Street, between 2nd and 3rd Avenues.

source2_quote: Start on 25 West 68th Street, the address to Peter's building, where he lives on the 12th floor in a two-bedroom apartment

household: with her brother Jamie
work: From the Mixed-Up Files of Mrs. Basil E. Frankweiler
creator: E. L. Konigsburg
notes: The children's real home is in Greenwich, Connecticut (outside scope). They run away and live secretly inside the Met for about a week, hiding in a restroom at closing time.
source_quote: She takes refuge in the Metropolitan Museum of Art (the Met) in New York City with her brother Jamie.

source2_quote: (Newsstand in a Times Sq. subway station; Nedick's lunch counter; Chinatown; Washington Sq. Park)

household: with Harry Cat
creator: George Selden
address_as_given: an abandoned drainpipe near the newsstand in the Times Square subway station
notes: A drainpipe inside the real Times Square station, near the fictional Bellini newsstand.
source_quote: Chester meets Tucker Mouse and Harry Cat, best friends who live in an abandoned drainpipe near the newsstand.

household: with her mother

work: Gossip Girl: Nobody Does It Better

household: with her mother, a painter

source2_quote: helps him to hide in an unused storage room

household: with her parents and twin brother

source2_quote: The apartment they liked best was a corner one with windows looking toward the east and south.

creator: Horatio Alger Jr.
geocode_query: Spruce Street and Nassau Street, Manhattan
notes: Dick's 'Box Hotel': a wooden box half full of straw, his chance shelter before he rents a room. Spruce Street is a short street by the old Tribune building. Serialized 1867, book 1868.

household: later with his roommate Henry Fosdick
creator: Horatio Alger Jr.

work: Mark, the Match Boy (looking back to Fame and Fortune)
creator: Horatio Alger Jr.
address_as_given: our old boarding-house in Bleecker Street
notes: Fosdick refers back to their earlier boarding house, presumably the one in the previous volume, Fame and Fortune (1868), which we did not check. Bleecker Street is long; placed mid-street with a wide radius.

household: with Henry Fosdick; their ward Mark later boards there

source2_quote: He paused in front of a shabby house, and went upstairs.

source2_quote: During the next three months Mark made his home at the Lodging House.

household: with his sister Rose and their stepfather Martin
creator: Horatio Alger Jr.
address_as_given: Leonard Street, between Centre and Baxter Streets
notes: The block east of the Tombs. Leonard Street between Centre and Baxter has since been absorbed into the courthouse district (we believe part became Hogan Place, unverified); the tenement is gone.
source_quote: Leonard Street, between Centre and Baxter Streets, is wretched and squalid
source2_quote: Here it was, however, that our hero and his sister lived.

household: with the seamstress Miss Manning
creator: Horatio Alger Jr.
address_as_given: Franklin Street, not far from the river
notes: Rough and Ready moves his sister here to escape their stepfather; he himself sleeps at the Newsboys' Lodging House and visits daily. The river is the Hudson (North River).
source_quote: In Franklin Street, not far from the river.
source2_quote: followed the seamstress down Franklin Street towards her home near the river.

household: with a band of street boys
creator: Horatio Alger Jr.
address_as_given: a room under the Dover Street wharf
geocode_query: Dover Street and South Street, Manhattan

source_quote: Down to Dover Street wharf.
source2_quote: It is situated not far from Fulton Ferry on the east side.

household: with his manservant Wong
creator: Steve Ditko and Stan Lee

source2_quote: When Doctor Stephen Strange became Sorcerer Supreme, he moved into 177A Bleecker St.

notes: The team hid out in the Sanctum during Civil War. Dates are from the Wikipedia summary.

source2_quote: It is located at the address 177A Bleecker Street in the Greenwich Village neighborhood of New York City.

source_quote: Located at 42nd Street and Madison Avenue in New York City
source2_quote: its five upper floors house the Fantastic Four's headquarters

household: childhood home
creator: Stan Lee and Jack Kirby

source2_quote: Yancy Street is named in reference to the real Delancey Street

source2_quote: The Henry Clay Frick House on 5th Avenue was the inspiration for the Avengers Mansion.

source2_quote: Avengers Mansion's address is 890 Fifth Avenue in the borough of Manhattan in New York City.
